name: FundedStreamBudget
description: Budget. Streams a token: the available amount grows each epoch, capped by what the DAO holds. Commits a checkpoint after each flow, so it needs CHECKPOINT_PERMISSION_ID for the DAO (and for an OpenFill bound to it).

inputs.name: dao
inputs.description: The installing DAO. In a recipe: DAO_REF.

inputs.name: token
inputs.description: The token streamed. 0xEeeeeEeeeEeEeeEeEeEeeEEEeeeeEeeeeeeeEEeE for native ETH.

inputs.name: amountPerEpoch
inputs.description: How much the available amount grows per epoch.

inputs.name: maxBudget
inputs.description: Maximum available amount at any time. 0 for no cap.
